clue.text: Make a song about money smelling

indicators.note: the song word goes round, about, the money word, enclosing it

parts.note: to make a song is to sing
a cent is a small coin, money

explanation.surface: Someone complains noisily about cash that stinks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make a song about' looks like the idiom for making a fuss, but 'about' is the container: SING goes round CENT.
explanation.definitionFit: A dog scenting its quarry is sniffing it out, so the word works as a synonym.

clue.text: Took steps in order to exterminate most rodents

indicators.note: in signals the letters sit inside the words that follow, killing off their outer letters

explanation.surface: Someone acted to wipe out nearly all the rats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Took steps' suggests taking action; it means walked. 'in order to exterminate' frames the run, which spans 'moST RODEnts'.
explanation.definitionFit: Strode is the past of stride, to walk with long steps.

clue.text: Slip away, needing a sleep

indicators.note: needing suggests the letters must be worked over into another order

explanation.surface: Dozing off for want of a nap.
explanation.definitionFit: Time that elapses passes or slips by.

clue.text: Stumble over egghead's garbage

indicators.note: in a down clue over places the first piece above the second

parts.note: to trip is to stumble
the head, first letter, of egg

explanation.surface: Tripping over a brainy person's rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Egghead' suggests an intellectual; it gives the first letter of egg.
explanation.definitionFit: Tripe is offal and also slang for nonsense or rubbish.

clue.text: A small number on the list will be outstanding

indicators.note: in a down clue on places one piece above the other

parts.note: NO is the short form of number
a table is a list of figures

explanation.surface: A minor figure in the rankings will stand out.
explanation.definitionFit: Notable means remarkable, striking, standing out.

clue.text: American lawyer turning in succession to guidance

indicators.note: turning means the lawyer's abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: a DA is a District Attorney, an American prosecutor
vice, as in vice-chairman, means in place of or succeeding

explanation.surface: A US attorney switches career to become someone's adviser.
explanation.definitionFit: Advice and guidance are synonyms: counsel offered to someone.

clue.text: Lavish with one's drink in time

indicators.note: the drinking pieces go inside the time word

parts.note: a date is a point in time
one is I, so one's gives I'S
to sip is to drink a little

explanation.surface: Generous with a person's drink at the appointed hour.
explanation.definitionFit: To dissipate a fortune is to squander it, spending lavishly.

clue.text: Though tired out holding a note, did it again

indicators.note: the rearranged word holds the note pieces inside it
out signals the word tired is put out of order

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Weary, but holding a musical note, a performer repeated it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges TIRED into ITERD, which holds A and TE.
explanation.definitionFit: Iterated means repeated, said or done once more.

clue.text: Making an admission about feed appeal

indicators.note: the admission word goes about, round, the feed word

parts.note: entry is admission to a place
to feed is to eat

explanation.surface: Admitting things around a plea for food.
explanation.definitionFit: An entreaty is an earnest plea or request.

clue.text: They're quite practical about a sphere of action

parts.note: re is Latin-derived for concerning, about
the lists were the enclosed arena for jousting, hence any field of combat

explanation.surface: People with sound sense deal with one area of activity.
explanation.definitionFit: Realists are hard-headed people who deal with things as they are, sensible and practical.

clue.text: Look-coppers being admitted into a party!

indicators.note: the coppers are admitted inside the party word, which encloses them

parts.note: a sect is a faction or party
P stands for pence, copper coins

explanation.surface: A glance at police officers being let into a celebration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coppers' suggests police, but here it means copper coins, pence, abbreviated P.
explanation.definitionFit: Aspect is a noun meaning appearance or the way something looks.

clue.text: This flag's one of the 30 across

definitions.meaning: the yellow flag is a wild water plant of that genus
a garden flower, one of those plants in blossom

explanation.surface: This banner belongs to a group named elsewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Iris is a flowering plant, and the yellow flag is a species of it.

clue.text: Deprive of arms, among other things

definitions.text: Deprive of arms, among other things

parts.words: Deprive of arms, among other things
parts.note: a playful reading of losing weapons, really taking off arms and legs as limbs

explanation.surface: Disarm someone, along with other measures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arms' suggests weapons and disarmament, but the clue means the body's limbs, which also include legs.
explanation.definitionFit: To dismember is to cut off the limbs of a body, arms included.

clue.text: Annie's get-up is really silly

indicators.note: a get-up is a costume, an outfit that rearranges the name's letters

parts.note: the name Annie, the possessive giving no letter

explanation.surface: Annie's outfit is utterly ridiculous.
explanation.definitionFit: Inane means senseless or foolish, the same as very silly.

clue.text: The head 21 across will make

definitions.meaning: the top of the head, the crown
a cook makes a meat or fish paste, the French spread

explanation.surface: The head of a kitchen produces something.
explanation.walkthrough: PATE (head) and PÂTÉ (the spread a cook makes) differ only in accents, which crosswords ignore.
explanation.definitionFit: Pate is old slang for the head; pâté is a paste a cook prepares.

clue.text: She alone gets an unpleasant task on an ocean-going vessel

indicators.note: in a down clue on places the task above the ship

parts.note: a chore is a tedious job
SS is a steamship

explanation.surface: A lone woman gets a grim job on board ship.
explanation.definitionFit: An anchoress was a female religious hermit, living alone.

clue.text: Oldest relations in a way

indicators.note: the relations word sits inside the street abbreviation

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way
relations are accounts or stories, tales

explanation.surface: The most elderly relatives lived on one road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relations' suggests family, but means narrations, tales.
explanation.definitionFit: Stalest means least fresh, the most aged.

clue.text: Stranger replaces a letter with cipher to become more powerful

indicators.note: one letter of the given word is swapped out for another

parts.note: a cipher is zero, written as O

explanation.surface: A newcomer uses a code to gain power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cipher' suggests code; it means zero, O, which replaces the A.
explanation.definitionFit: Stronger is the comparative of strong, meaning more powerful.

clue.text: Sign language

parts.note: read as body language, signals made with hands and arms

explanation.surface: Communication by signing.
explanation.definitionFit: Hand movements are a language of signs.

clue.text: Well content in Wonderland

parts.note: in Alice's Adventures in Wonderland the Dormouse tells of sisters living in a well full of a sticky syrup

explanation.surface: Feeling satisfied in a magical land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Well content' reads as very happy; it is the contents of a well in Lewis Carroll's story.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dormouse's tale in the Mad Hatter's tea party features a well of golden syrup.

clue.text: It's a bad thing to be retrogressive

indicators.note: retrogressive means going backwards, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: to live is to exist, to be

explanation.surface: Going backwards is a bad thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Evil as a noun is wickedness, something bad.

clue.text: Such efficiency reveals the experienced cook

indicators.note: reveals means the letters are shown within the words before it, spanning them

explanation.surface: Kitchen efficiency marks out a seasoned cook.
explanation.definitionFit: A chef is a professional cook, typically skilled.

clue.text: Assets invested in London

definitions.meaning: the chief city of the UK, seat of government

explanation.surface: Funds put into the British metropolis.
explanation.definitionFit: Capital is wealth used for investment, and London is the UK's capital city.

clue.text: To cut the horse's tail is really distressing

parts.note: to sever is to cut off

indicators.note: the tail of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: Docking a horse's tail is upsetting.
explanation.definitionFit: Severe means serious or harsh, causing great distress.

clue.text: Makes up for having no seat perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps means the letters given may be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: Compensating for having nowhere to sit.
explanation.definitionFit: To atone is to make amends.

clue.text: A barbecue might be best

definitions.meaning: a barbecue is an outdoor party
to best someone is to beat or surpass them

explanation.surface: A cookout could be the finest option.
explanation.definitionFit: To outdo is to surpass or beat; a barbecue is a party held outside, an out-do.

clue.text: Snappy little devil having a link with conservationists

parts.note: an imp is a small demon or mischievous child
a tie is a connection or bond
NT is the National Trust, the British heritage conservation charity

explanation.surface: A bad-tempered rascal has ties to a conservation group.
explanation.definitionFit: Snappy can mean irritable and short-tempered, the same as impatient.

clue.text: Trunk or boot or some other name for a container

indicators.note: a container holds something, so the words hold the letters within them

explanation.surface: A car's trunk or boot is another word for a storage space.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trunk' and 'boot' suggest car storage or luggage; trunk is the body.
explanation.definitionFit: The torso is the trunk of the human body.

clue.text: Order that will keep hose in place

definitions.meaning: the Order of the ..., England's senior order of chivalry

definitions.text: that will keep hose in place
definitions.meaning: a band worn to hold up stockings

explanation.surface: An instruction for holding stockings up.
explanation.definitionFit: A garter is an elastic band holding up stockings, and names Britain's highest order of knighthood.

clue.text: A swimmer urges not working out

indicators.note: working out suggests the letters being reworked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone at the pool insists against doing a gym session.
explanation.definitionFit: The sturgeon is a large fish, the source of caviar, so it swims.

clue.text: Combat is in the balance

indicators.note: the word is goes inside the balance word

parts.note: the rest is the remainder, the balance

explanation.surface: A fight hangs in the balance.
explanation.definitionFit: To resist is to oppose or fight against, as to combat does.

clue.text: Flora's underwear

parts.note: Flora is a girl's name and also plant life; flowers in blossom share a name with baggy knickers

explanation.surface: A woman named Flora's knickers.
explanation.walkthrough: Flora looks like a woman's name, but it is plant life, whose flowering plants are bloomers.
explanation.definitionFit: Bloomers are loose knee-length knickers, and flowering plants in bloom.
